name: DUAL CAMERA + FP CONTROLS
changes: first person is the default gameplay camera
F3 toggles first person and 3/4 development camera
W/S forward-back, A/D strafe, diagonal movement supported
arrow keys remain available for movement/rotation
ceiling and full-height walls render only in first person
3/4 retains cutaway walls and visible player sprite
mobile receives separate Q/E rotate buttons
